details: Optimized the Mapbox-based ad geo-targeting system by implementing custom pbf tiles, adding new filtering features, and leading the migration from country-generated to dynamic styling.
Contributed to the migration of the in-house product customizer from jQuery to React.

Implemented improved internationalization (i18n) management using Lokalize.
Improved website performance (Lighthouse 'F' to 'A'), reduced carbon footprint by 75% (2g to 0.5g CO2/page), and decreased load time by 70% (10s to <3s).
Led a team of 3 front-end developers, providing mentorship and technical guidance.

Developed a custom solution for a multi-technology micro-frontends architecture using React and Angular.
